steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: We searched all over the shelter, but didn't find the Chief anywhere. What's going on?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: He seemed off when he came back yesterday. Could it be possible that...
steps.female_content: She seemed off when she came back yesterday. Could it be possible that...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: But those two Sinners are still here. They're sound asleep... Things should be fine. Raven didn't say anything either, right?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Speaking of Raven, I heard she handed over several poetry books to the ruins patrol team... ${PlayerName} didn't want to sacrifice any team members last time. Did that lunatic go down into the mine alone this time...?
Raven sits at her desk, her head resting on one hand, her eyes shut and resting.
Her poetry book is falling deep into the mine. The pages scatter and float down, down, down... before finally landing in the pool, soaking up the contamination. The intense Mania makes her frown.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>O souls of the abyss, tell me your woes... Let me hear your unspoken cries, so that I may convey them...</color>
The ink gradually separates from the paper, merging into an ink-colored snake that swims into the depths of the contamination.
The murky whispers gradually seep into her consciousness. A plethora of eras, people, and emotions overwhelm her.

Raven's brows furrow deeper and deeper. Her eyes are shut as if she's having a nightmare. Her consciousness is being chewed away. Her quill pen dances wildly on the paper, scribbling down words no one can understand.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Speak to me... and show me the way...</color>

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: ...Wow, I dozed off. Consciousness in the abyss is terrifying.
There seemed to be some familiar faces. Raven is inches away from grasping the truth, but she has to take a rest first. This has been too mentally draining for her.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Better go see those two kids first. Got a lot of explaining to do...
Forcing herself up, she wobbles to Hecate and Hella's room and knocks on the door.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Are you up, my dears?
No one responds. Raven realizes the door isn't locked.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: ...No way. I'm in no condition to chase them down...
She pushes open the door. Several elite Rustfire combatants lay sprawled on the ground unconscious. The two Sinners had long disappeared.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huff... Huff... Huff... Hecate! Wait! Wait up!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We should go back and clarify things. They all say the contamination in Inner Bay is abnormal. The shackles are not responding. We don't even know where ${PlayerName} is!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief will come back for sure. If it weren't for us, he wouldn't have left.
steps.female_content: Chief will come back for sure. If it weren't for us, she wouldn't have left.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What are you talking about? Those are just random guesses from the Rustfire folks. ${PlayerName} never said that.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's because I'm too weak. I became a burden, so he went about the mission alone. I'm so useless. I must find him and protect him, or else I...
steps.female_content: It's because I'm too weak. I became a burden, so she went about the mission alone. I'm so useless. I must find her and protect her, or else I...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Watch out!!
Several remnant Nirvana mechs suddenly rush out!
